attchmntText: Viceroy Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Viceroy Hotels Limited has filed an audio recording of the Post Earnings Group Conference Call held on 13th November, 2026. The call covered the financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The audio file is available for download at the URL https://www.viceroyhotels.in/files/13.11.2026_Audio%20Recording.mp3. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The notice was issued by Company Secretary C. Siva Kumar Reddy.

attchmntText: Viceroy Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release for the period ended 30.09.2026.".
voiceSummary: Viceroy Hotels Limited announced unaudited financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated total income rose 61% year on year to 93.99 crore rupees. EBITDA increased 81% to 24.68 crore rupees. Profit after tax grew 2.7 times to 3.68 crore rupees. The company completed a rights issue of 105.83 crore rupees. This involved allotting 92,03,008 equity shares at 115 rupees per share. Net worth increased to 375.90 crore rupees. Debt to equity ratio improved to 0.70 times. Marriott Executive Apartments was fully integrated into the company from October 1, 2026. An upgraded banquet space is scheduled to reopen on December 1, 2026. A new banquet hall will open on January 1, 2027.

attchmntText: Viceroy Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Viceroy Hotels Limited filed a presentation with BSE and NSE on November 13, 2026, regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. H1 FY27 EBITDA grew 81% year-on-year to Rs. 24.7 Cr. Q2 total income rose 53% year-on-year to Rs. 48.8 Cr. Cash and equivalents stood at Rs. 110.5 Cr at the end of H1. The company plans to double its convention centre to 20,000 sq ft by December 2026. Phase III upgrades, including Marriott rooms and a rooftop bar, are scheduled for FY28. A 200-key greenfield Courtyard by Marriott project is in the pipeline at Madhapur.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: Viceroy Hotels Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited regarding the Rights Issue aggregating to 105.83 crore. The report confirms no deviation from the objects of the issue. During the quarter, the company utilized 2.92 crore. Specifically, 2.87 crore was used for general corporate purposes, including vendor payments and borrowings repayment, and 0.05 crore for issue expenses. The total unutilized proceeds stand at 102.92 crore. These unutilized funds are deployed in fixed deposits with Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd, maturing on October 03, 2026. The implementation of all objects remains ongoing within the FY 2026-27 timeline.

desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Viceroy Hotels Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026 during its Board meeting on 12.11.2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 3,506.63 lakhs for the quarter and 6,780.55 lakhs for the half year. Standalone profit before tax stood at 41.97 lakhs for the quarter and 151.54 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 0.28 for the quarter and 0.44 for the half year. The company completed a rights issue of 92,03,008 equity shares at Rs. 115 each, aggregating Rs. 10,583.46 lakhs, allotted on 15.09.2026. The statutory auditors, MSKC & Associates LLP, issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were identified. The results are subject to final scrutiny and reporting requirements.

attchmntText: Viceroy Hotels Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Viceroy Hotels Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting on November 12, 2026. The company reported a half-year profit of 292.88 lakhs and basic earnings per share of 0.44. During the quarter, the company completed a rights issue of 92,03,008 equity shares at Rs. 115 each, raising 10,583.46 lakhs for debt repayment and general corporate purposes. Shares were allotted on September 15, 2026. Additionally, a novation agreement executed on September 29, 2026, replaced the wholly owned subsidiary with the holding company as the owner for the Marriott Executive Apartments in Hyderabad, effective October 1, 2026. The statutory auditors conducted a limited review and reported no material misstatements.
